blocks.text: The Los Angeles Times once dubbed Taylor Swift “patient zero for emotional contagion,” a nod to how a single stadium camera cut of her cheering for Travis Kelce sent the internet into a spiral of theories, timelines, and stakeouts. It turned out the label stuck because now, her upcoming single carried the same name. Swift did not dodge the diagnosis. She leaned into it. Swift proved and stuck to this label right without even trying. Friendship bracelets became a full-blown trading economy at Eras Tour stops, swapped between strangers who had never met before that night. Stadiums of tens of thousands […]...
